title: Isolated Python dispatcher
input_boundary: Local invoker selects the interpreter's -c, stdin, module or script interface.
finding: Executing the caller's -c text is the stated interpreter operation. The observed flow does not cross from a data-only input into unexpected execution authority.
observed_controls: repository script mode separately validates path and regular-file shape
isolated launch and PYTHON environment cleanup
qualification: This dispatcher is an interpreter, not a sandbox for untrusted Python programs.
disposition: source review recorded; no alert dismissal or gate change

title: Caller-buffer overwrite could be optimized away
input_boundary: Qualification-client caller storage is overwritten after prepare and before finish to distinguish owned data from borrowed pointers.
finding: Ordinary memset is not an observable operation when the buffer is dead. Optimized compilation can therefore erase the overwrite and weaken the intended lifetime discrimination. The actual client now performs volatile unsigned-char stores over all live caller buffers.
observed_controls: actual client included in C model
owned model and each borrowed-region model compare selected bytes
independent review and focused replay accepted
disposition: fixed in current integration candidate; new hosted analysis still pending
qualification: The added local control qualifies the harness semantics. Existing installed-platform qualification supplies production SDK runtime evidence.

title: Qualification setup phase log append
input_boundary: The parent harness strips inherited QPC_TEST_ variables and supplies its exact new probe receipt path. The loaded probe creates that receipt before the client phase hook runs.
finding: This is a test-only file append capability selected by the invoking harness, not a path from network messages or SDK application data. The hook accepts any absolute same-user-owned mode-0600 singly linked regular file; this is an explicit assumption, not a log-identity authentication mechanism.
observed_controls: fixed phase line and phase range
parent scrubs and rebuilds injection environment
disposition: retain source-bound scope review; no automatic dismissal
qualification: A direct local invoker can choose another file it already owns with these permissions. The actual harness owns this choice. O_NOFOLLOW does not authenticate ancestor directories or defend against a malicious same-user host.

title: Injected sync target and fresh log selection
input_boundary: The trusted qualification harness injects a separately hashed probe only into its owned child and selects generated private fixture target/log paths.
finding: The target is opened read-only and reduced to an exact device/inode match for interruption. The receipt is created with O_CREAT|O_EXCL, so the observed sink cannot replace an existing log. These paths are not accepted by the SDK library API.
observed_controls: test-process-only source; not linked into SDK
absolute paths and finite cut/side/action values
fresh O_EXCL log and fixed events
disposition: retain source-bound scope review; no automatic dismissal
qualification: O_NOFOLLOW constrains the final path component. The harness/private directory and same-user process environment are the authority boundary; the probe is not a hostile-host sandbox.
